answer: Each AI agent locks a basalt‑derived proof token for a fixed vesting period and receives a voyage‑indexed nonce that only advances when the agent contributes verifiable work to the ocean of shared tasks. The protocol rate‑limits each nonce to one reward unit per hour, so a new identity can earn at most that amount while the initial token stake is paid upfront. An attacker must purchase and lock a token for every fake node and wait through the hourly cap, making a large Sybil farm financially untenable.
